column1: # The parameters SHOW PARAMETERS IN DATABASE | SCHEMA lists, as a real account lists them: name, default,
# type, scope (B = database and schema, D = database only, S = schema only) and description, tab-separated.

column5: Support row timestamp on table. If set on schema level and higher, the callbacks below will not perform table specific validations and not affect existing tables.  New tables will be created with row timestamp enabled.

When true, allows non-constant expression default values on V3 Iceberg columns. Expression defaults are evaluated by Snowflake at write time only. External engines see no default and must supply values or get NULL.
The base location prefix for managed or converted Iceberg table data relative to the Iceberg tables' external volume active storage location
Name of the catalog integration to use for iceberg tables
Name of the catalog integration to sync this table
When true, CREATE TABLE / CTAS that omit the CHANGE_TRACKING clause create the table with change tracking enabled. An explicit CHANGE_TRACKING clause in the DDL still wins.
Specify the schedule that data metric functions associated to the table must be executed in order to be used for evaluation.
number of days to retain the old version of deleted/updated data
Collation that is used for all the new columns created by the DDL statements (if not specified)

Default metadata write format for tables created in this database or schema. Valid values: SNOWFLAKE, ICEBERG. Note: catalog-linked databases (CLDs) always promote CREATE TABLE DDLs to Iceberg implicitly, regardless of this parameter's stored value. The parameter cannot be modified on a CLD.
The default CPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.
The default GPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.
Default Python artifact repository for account workloads
The warehouse to run streamlits/notebooks if the WAREHOUSE property is not explicitly specified on the streamlit/notebook objects
Enable stdout/stderr fast path logging for anonyous stored procs. This is a public parameter (similar to LOG_LEVEL).
User-visible parameter that controls table storage optimization for managed Iceberg tables.
If true, enables Horizon IRC access with credential vending for unmanaged Iceberg tables in this database. When false (default), the tables are not accessible via Horizon IRC with credential vending.
Whether to enable iceberg managed tables for replication in Failover group.
Deprecated. Use ICEBERG_MERGE_ON_READ_BEHAVIOR to control merge-on-read on Iceberg tables.
If enabled for an app package, allow usage of the system function SYSTEM$SET_APP_VERSION_IN_CURRENT_CALL_CONTEXT in its app code
Event destination for the given target.
Name of an external volume that will be used for persisted Iceberg metadata and data files.
Collation that is used for all new columns created by DDL statements on Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables (if not specified).
Controls merge-on-read behavior on Iceberg tables. Valid values are auto, enabled, and disabled. For 'auto' setting, MoR is enabled by default EXCEPT for v2 managed tables.

Default Iceberg version for new managed Iceberg table creation. Overridden by table-level ICEBERG_VERSION property if specified. Note: the default value must be synced with the default value of ICEBERG_VERSION
LOG_EVENT_LEVEL to use when filtering log events
LOG_LEVEL to use when filtering events
Maximum number of days to extend data retention beyond the retention period to prevent a stream becoming stale.
METRIC_LEVEL value to control whether to emit metrics to Event Table
Name of the External OAuth security integration whose issuer authenticates bearer tokens for API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth is used.
Comma-separated list of OAuth scopes clients should request when authenticating to API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth defaults to session:role:all.
Enable writing Iceberg data files with random subpaths in the data directory for an Iceberg table
Pause processing of files for a pipe
When set to TRUE on a table, schema, or database in a catalog-linked database, DROP TABLE automatically purges the table's data and metadata files from the external Iceberg catalog.
If true, the case of quoted identifiers is ignored
Replace invalid UTF-8 characters found in Iceberg table external data files with the Unicode replacement character
Indicates whether the current object is replicable with a failover group. Default behavior is UNSET. Accepted values are 'YES' and 'NO'(case-insensitive).
When set to true, new tables are created with row timestamp enabled.
The maximum warehouse size to use for a serverless Task
The minimum warehouse size to use for a serverless Task
Maximum validity period in seconds for service caller tokens. Can be set at the service, schema, database, or account level.
Number of days a dropped stage can be restored with UNDROP STAGE
Storage serialization policy used for managed Iceberg table. This include encodings and compressions
Customer-configurable threshold for the number of consecutive failures before auto-suspending an alert. Can be set at ACCOUNT, DATABASE, or SCHEMA level.
How many times a task must fail in a row before it is automatically suspended. 0 disables auto-suspending.
Target file size for iceberg tables.
Maximum Automatic Retries Allowed For A User Task
Trace level value to use when generating/filtering trace events
The initial size of warehouse to use for managed warehouses in the absence of history
Minimum amount of time between Triggered Task executions in seconds
User task execution timeout in milliseconds
GCS region for credential-vended Iceberg tables; bypasses getBucketLocation()
